id: title:Gilbert09:treat a 404 from credential validation as an invalid token

review.reason: Adds status code 404 to credential rejection handling alongside 400 and 401, potentially distinguishing account-not-found from malformed-token scenarios. This is a narrow, localized maintenance and behavior correction.
review.uncertainty: The shared message may not distinguish account-not-found from malformed-token scenarios; actual benefit depends on downstream handling and user interpretation, not demonstrated in this hunk.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds status code 404 to credential rejection handling.
observations.code_quote: # malformed at the gateway before it is ever looked up. A 404 here isn't documented for
observations.posthog_connection: The Vercel warehouse connector now treats 404 responses alongside 400 and 401 as credential errors, returning an invalid token message. This could help users distinguish account-not-found scenarios from malformed-token scenarios, though the shared message may not distinguish them. The implementation adds 404 to the rejection set and documents an observed behavior.
